8.3.2.5 Dcm_ SetActiveDiagnostic
[SWS_Dcm_01068] Definition of API function Dcm_SetActiveDiagnostic ⌈
Service Name
Dcm_SetActiveDiagnostic
Syntax
Std_ReturnType Dcm_SetActiveDiagnostic (
boolean active
)
Service ID [hex]
0x56
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Reentrant
Parameters (in)
active
If false Dcm shall not call ComM_DCM_ActiveDiagnostic(). If true
Dcm will call ComM_DCM_ActiveDiagnostic().
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
Std_ReturnType
E_OK: this value is always returned.
Description
Allows to activate and deactivate the call of ComM_DCM_ActiveDiagnostic() function.
Available via
Dcm.h
⌋()
